channel.title: Splendid Engines: Writing
channel.description: Considered essays and reports from Splendid Engines.

item.title: Tell the Truth Faster: Ian Koff on Fractional Leadership, AI Friction and Building STRATOS
item.description: Ian Koff on fractional creative leadership, fixing stale creative systems, using AI for friction and building the STRATOS weather-readiness platform.

item.title: Susan Arendt on Why Attention Is Earned, Not Owed
item.description: Highwire's Susan Arendt on why content is people trying to reach people, why you cannot run creative teams like machines, and how to use AI without losing the plot.

item.title: Marketers: Stop Personalizing and Get Personal.
item.description: Personalized outbound is bumming me out.

item.title: Why Your Best Content Should Reach The Fewest People
item.description: Most B2B companies chase mass appeal content. The data says that's the wrong call.

item.title: The Community Interview Does Three Jobs. Most Teams Only See One.
item.description: Most B2B teams treat the community interview as a content step. It's your warmest sales motion. Here's why it works and how to run one.

item.title: Lomit Patel on the B2B sale you're losing before the meeting starts
item.description: Lomit Patel, CGMO at TYB, on why B2B buyers decide before the demo and what vendors should do upstream to win the pre-meeting research.

item.title: I Ditched My Keyboard for an Xbox Controller. Work Has Never Been More Fun.
item.description: Claude, wireless headphones, and an Xbox controller. More done and more fun. Here's my setup.

item.title: The B2B Trust Gap
item.description: Your buyers trust each other, not you. Not yet.

item.title: Taissia Belozerova On Balancing Data and Instinct in Community Marketing
item.description: Bidease Sr Director of Commercial Ops Taissia Belozerova shares how a mix of data-backed decisions and gut instinct can propel marketing teams.

item.title: How Morgan Friberg Helped Build a Winning Community Marketing Program
item.description: Liftoff's Morgan Friberg on how community marketing builds B2B trust vendors can't fake — and how to scale it across the funnel.

item.title: PFU's Ellen Zarate On Leveraging AI Without Killing Customer Trust
item.description: Scalability and value are now inversely correlated. Learn why Ellen Zarate treats AI as an intern and prioritizes unscalable human connection to win.

item.title: How Veteran Marketer Scott Reyburn Builds Trust and Accelerates Pipeline Through Content
item.description: Veteran content marketer Scott Reyburn reveals proven strategies for creating B2B content that earns attention and drives revenue.

item.title: GTM Veteran Ted Verani Talks Community-Led Marketing For B2B
item.description: Want to learn how Ted Verani uses community-driven strategies to power B2B growth? Five actionable takeaways for marketers, sales teams, and SaaS founders.
